attchmntText: Prime Securities Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Prime Securities Limited filed advertisements regarding the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was issued on November 16, 2026, pursuant to Regulations 33 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The financial results were published in newspapers and are available on the company website. The document includes an extract of the standalone financials for Rexnord Electronics and Controls Limited, showing a net profit after tax of 604.55 Lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. It also contains consolidated financial data for Prime Securities Limited, reporting a net profit after tax of 1,839 Lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Earnings per share for Prime Securities Limited were 3.91 basic and 3.81 diluted for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The filing was signed by N. Jayakumar, Managing Director and Group CEO.

attchmntText: Prime Securities Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Prime Securities Limited reported unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a loss after tax of Rs. 384 lakhs, with basic earnings per share of Rs. 1.06. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the loss after tax was Rs. 1,187 lakhs. The auditor's report noted an exceptional item of Rs. 2,795 lakhs related to a settlement claim. The report also highlighted that the associate company, Ark Neo Financial Services Private Limited, has a negative net worth and relies on support from the holding company. The auditor did not modify their conclusion regarding these matters.
